intro: Stonetalon Sap is a sticky, potent substance harvested directly from the lumbering sap beasts that roam the craggy heights of the Stonetalon Mountains. It serves as a key reagent for the Darkspear witch doctor Jin'Zil, who uses its raw woodland properties to concoct a spiteful brew.
